messages:
jun: Customer report: duplicate token charges after streaming truncation + route failover. Minimal logs attached.
lee: Likely the session headers are cleared on route swap so retry looks like a fresh request.
ara: Log snippet: ```2026-04-01T09:02:10Z stream EOF seq=2048; toolcall id=tc-A1; 2026-04-01T09:02:11Z route swap -> clear ephemeral headers; 2026-04-01T09:02:11Z reconnect replay -> toolcall id=tc-A1-R```
jun: Two mitigations: require client idempotency/session id OR server fallback dedupe. Can't force clients immediately.
lee: Proposal: server compute fingerprint = sha256(normalize(payload)+tool_name) and suppress second provisional billing when: same fingerprint, same customer id, prior event is PROVISIONAL, and reconnect happened within 600ms. Record a suppression record rather than deleting events.
ara: Telemetry: emit dedupe.applied, dedupe.fingerprint, dedupe.outcome and link trace id for console. Backfill fingerprints for 7d to measure false-positive rate.
console-team: UI: show "Provisional (suppressed)" badge, hover text explaining heuristic, and "View raw events" link. Add filter for suppressed/provisional charges.
billing-bot: Feature-flag created: server_dedupe_retry; per-customer opt-out tag no_server_dedupe. Canary window planned.
jun: Ownership: lee -> server patch & tests; ara -> telemetry dashboards; console-team -> UI mock. ETA: server 10d, telemetry 4d, UI next sprint.
lee: Will include emergency kill switch in control plane and preserve raw immutable events.
arA: Reminder: suppression only affects billing events, not actual tool execution; document for customers.
jun: Created ticket RW-9302 and scheduled a 5% canary on 2026-04-08. Ping RW-9302 for updates.
